title: Chapter 413
paragraphs: Chapter 413
Episode 120. Why Hiran? (7)
"Gr… andpa…"
Dante strained to speak, but his voice didn't carry far as he had just woken up and was still weak. Jin, who was right beside him, could barely hear the faint voice.
However, that small call caught Ron's attention, and he turned his head towards Jin and Dante standing on the outer wall.
"Gr, Grandpa!"
With a smile, Ron looked at his grandson. He was covered in blood, but fortunately, it didn't seem to be all his own.
'I can't believe Ron suffered such injuries... I expected an intense battle, as Velact is undoubtedly one of the strongest in the world.'
Seeing the injured Ron in person, Jin found it hard to believe the reality. Excluding Shiron, Ron was a contender for the title of the world's strongest.
'On top of that, Velact's injuries seem to be lighter.'
Is Velact stronger than Ron?
It was hard to accept at first. Jin had heard countless stories and praise about Ron since his previous life, while Velact was a person he first met in this life.
Jin had recently realized that Velact was Rosa's rival, but that was all he knew.
Velact was not a well-known figure in the martial world. Even Ron and Velact seemed to be meeting for the first time.
"Calm down, Dante."
Dante struggled. He wanted to move towards his grandfather, but he was so exhausted that he could barely budge.
"Ha, but. My grandfather."
"Here is the Sword Emperor's castle, and that man is Ron Hiran, the world's greatest knight. Is there any chance your grandfather would be defeated?"
In the heart of the Sword Emperor's castle, Ron Hiran being defeated by someone...
It was something no one in the world could easily imagine. Unless Run Kandel or Zifel launched a full-scale attack, it was universally recognized as an impossible feat.
Even if Emperor Bimonte led a huge army himself, there were many doubts about whether they could conquer the Sword Emperor's castle guarded by Ron.
The world is vast.
It wasn't an unbelievable story that Velact was stronger than Ron.
However, Jin had an intuition that something else was involved.
He calmed his surprised heart and carefully examined the battlefield once again.

The collapsed outer walls and the shape of the buildings were unfamiliar. The cut surfaces were too rough for something destroyed by sword energy. It looked grotesque, as if a giant had torn it apart.

Of course, fragments from the clash of their sword energies could have scattered randomly, and it could be due to the shockwave, but that explanation was insufficient. Most of the debris was burnt to a crisp.
Jin looked up at the sky.
'Grunil…'
The aerial battleship Grunil of Kinzelro.
Black smoke was billowing from the cannon at the forefront of Grunil.
"Is Sir Lon being pushed back because of that cannon?"
At that moment, the cannon started gathering magical power.
Buzzzzz-!
From Jin's perspective, an enormous amount of energy was building up in the cannon. It was shocking that such energy could be gathered without any warning.
"This is crazy!"
Just before the cannon fired, Jin hastily set up a protective barrier.
Kwaaaaaa...!
The cannon unleashed a massive lightning attack.
The flash of light made the surroundings brighter than daylight, blinding the eyes, and the shockwave spreading from the cannon not only tore the clouds but also struck the ground.
An invisible sword energy, too huge to even estimate its size, blocked the cannon. It was the sword energy of Lon Hiran. Its role was to break down the cannon before it reached the ground.
The broken cannon, filled with ominous blue light, rained down on Hiran Castle like a meteor shower. The knights and soldiers of Hiran desperately blocked the fragments of the cannon.
The aftermath of the cannon struck Jin's protective barrier harshly.
Dante, with his bloodshot eyes trembling, clenched his teeth in frustration. He also vomited a mouthful of blood, which was due to his heightened agitation causing a faster reflux reaction.
"Kuaaa...!"
"Dante, please listen to me. Calm down. As soon as the explosion is over, I'll send you back immediately. Think about Sir Lon, he wouldn't want you to get hurt more."
A moment from the past in the Colon ruins, when they faced Kozek, came to mind.
It could be asserted.

The power of the airship Grunil was incomparably stronger than Kozek back then. At that time, Talaris alone blocked most of the cannon fire, and Jin almost died while blocking the falling fragments for the natives.

Now, there were thousands of knights and soldiers in Hiran Castle. Unlike during the Colon incident, all of them were blocking the fragments, but it seemed insufficient to prevent the castle from breaking apart.
'So this is the reason they dared to break into Hiran Castle with such confidence.'
But Hiran is Hiran.
Originally, with just one or at most two shots, it wouldn't be surprising if Hiran Castle crumbled entirely. However, because of Lon, they were holding on.
His invisible sword energy, like the broken cannon, blocked the falling fragments of the cannon.
In other words, Lon was not only fighting against Berakt but also protecting the entire friendly camp.
A magnificent feat that couldn't be described by the adjective 'strong' alone.
That's why, even though the situation was not good, Jin didn't picture Hiran Castle falling today.
'Kinzel, those bastards surely don't plan to annihilate Hiran. If they did, they wouldn't have isolated Bechukel's party in Hiran Castle from the beginning.'
Furthermore, the fact that they were firing the cannon meant they had already secured Bechukel's party, which implied a high probability of retreating soon.
The shockwave hitting the barrier was subsiding.
"Shuri, send Dante to the healers. It seems like the healing center is also destroyed, so send him to the most outstanding healers in the rear of the battlefield."
[Myanya!]
Jin spoke as he tied Dante to Shuri's back. Dante was in a state where he didn't even have the strength to hold onto Shuri.
Just before Shuri started to move, Jin firmly grabbed Dante's shoulder.
"My fight is your fight, and your fight is my fight. Today, I'll fight for both of us. I won't let those trash-like guys get away easily, so take care of yourself."
Dante blinked his red eyes as a substitute for a response.
As Shuri began to move by jumping off the wall, Jin's eyes turned cold.
As soon as the aftermath ended, Ron and Belrakt's swords were colliding.
"If you had followed my suggestion and moved, there would have been a mountain of corpses, Ron Hyran!"
Ron didn't respond, just swinging his Rashid.
However, it wasn't that he couldn't respond due to the overwhelming force, but rather that there was no reason to talk to a beast who didn't understand a shred of honor.
Their fight seemed to be evenly matched. If it weren't for the warship Grunnel, Ron might have gained some advantage.
-You will gain a great benefit, Jin.
Suddenly, the words Marjiella mouthed when the situation started came to mind.
Looking at the damaged Geumhwang Fortress, something hot welled up inside.
Geumhwang Fortress was a friend's home, and also a place where people would someday fight alongside him against Ziephel.
'Benefit? I'll make you guys suffer so much that you'll never do this kind of thing again...'
Swooosh...
Spiritual energy gathered in the Brada Mante. It was the energy to unfold the last resort saved for confronting the bandits.
Spirit Sword Special Technique
Dark Light Invocation
The sword wrapped in spiritual energy slashed through the air.
Then, following the trajectory of the sword, the space turned dark. What the spiritual energy created was a black gate leading to the world of the ancient Nameless Clan.
It was impossible to predict which sibling would appear through the Dark Light Invocation.
Even if an ordinary warrior was summoned, they would greatly help in turning the tide of the battle. Jin concentrated and completed the special technique.
And when the spiritual energy dispersed, and a sibling emerged from the black gate,
Jin couldn't help but smile with satisfaction.
The one who came out of the gate was Sado King Linfa.
"It's been... a while, Jin brother. I got... lucky."
Though his speech was a bit awkward since he hadn't been long since finishing his vow of silence training, in those few words.
The powerful energy contained in it was deep and strong enough for everyone in the battlefield to look up at the outer wall in shock.
'Who is that person?'
'Could it be, a new enemy...?'
'No, he's with Jin Runcandel. He seems to be an ally.'
'Even so, where did he suddenly come from?'
While the warriors exchanged glances and opinions, Linfa drew the greatsword on his back.
Whooong-!
Even just drawing the sword, a heavy sword wind was blowing all around.
"I'm sorry for calling you, Linfa brother."
"No... I like it. Are those... the enemies?"
Linfa pointed his greatsword at the warship Grunnel and Belrakt.
"What do you want... Jin brother?"
"Annihilation of the enemies."
Linfa nodded at the resolute answer.
"I understand......"
The warship Grunnel was reloading its cannons. Ron gathered strength to stop the cannons, and Belrakt couldn't take his eyes off Linfa.
'Is that... the Nameless Clan the Commander talked about?'
A strange feeling he had never experienced before was confusing Belrakt's mind.
He had never even faced them with a sword. Naturally, he had never fought against the Nameless Clan, and only heard that their power was extraordinary. He hadn't directly experienced anything.
Yet, he felt so nauseous and his body hair stood on end that he was sure if it had been other warriors of his clan, their legs would have given out.
A dreadful sense of crisis was pressing down on his body. Belrakt, who had not felt a single fear even when facing Ron Hyran.
'Ha, nonsense...! I am Belrakt Sidrikar, the strongest warrior of the White Wolf Clan. How strong could that thing be?'
Kyaaaaa!
Belrakt roared, regaining his composure. Now his heart was filled with anger towards Linfa, not fear.
"I am... the great... fourth Nameless King... Linfa."
The cannon had finished aiming, and everyone on the battlefield was preparing for the hellish aftermath.
However, Linfa, who had witnessed the tremendous thunder in the cannon with his own eyes, continued his words in a calm voice.
"Having answered... my brother's call... I came here. My job is to be his... sword. As for the enemies......"
Leave your last words.
Flash-!
As soon as Linfa finished speaking, the cannon spewed thunder, staining the ground with a purple hue.
